definitions.explanation: Suffix naming the rule or arrangement under which something operates: {予約|よやく}{制|せい} means run on a reservation basis, {会員|かいいん}{制|せい} means members only. Attaches to a noun describing the organizing principle, and the compound often stands alone as a notice.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予約|よやく}{制|せい}→予約制：07058_yoyakusei⟧です。
examples.english: This restaurant is by reservation only.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}{制|せい}→会員制：16796_kaiinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I go to a members-only gym.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{週休二日|しゅうきゅうふつか}{制|せい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: From next month we'll be on a full two-day weekend system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧{制|せい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{成果|せいか}{主義|しゅぎ}→成果主義：18880_seikashugi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{移行|いこう}→移行：13776_ikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more companies are shifting from a seniority system to performance-based pay.

notes:
Very productive in notices and workplace vocabulary. The compound is usually used with だ/です or attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{予約|よやく}{制|せい}→予約制：07058_yoyakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{予約|よやく}{制|せい}→予約制：07058_yoyakusei⟧: by reservation only
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}{制|せい}→会員制：16796_kaiinsei⟧: membership-based
- ⟦{交代|こうたい}{制|せい}→交代制：18781_koutaisei⟧: shift system
- ⟦{定額|ていがく}{制|せい}→定額制：17050_teigakusei⟧: flat-rate; subscription
- {二部|にぶ}{制|せい}: two-shift or two-session system
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧{制|せい}: self-declaration system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of; made by — identical in sound, completely different meaning (⟦{日本|にほん}{製|せい}→日本製：28455_nihonsei⟧ made in Japan); the kanji is the only clue in speech
- 〜{式|しき}: style; type; method — ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{式|しき} automatic-type; describes how a thing works, not the rules people operate under
- ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: system; institution — the free-standing noun for the same idea
